fact: The ministry unveiled on 2026-09-08 a sovereign AI platform whose first phase includes Idarati AI, a digital assistant guiding users through administrative procedures.
LesEco says Idarati AI, an agentic assistant on the sovereign marketplace, guides users through administrative procedures and is among the first operational components.
The digital transition minister told the Chamber of Representatives of the launch of the AI-based project IdaratiIA, within the Idarati digital public services programme.

Tech Review Africa reports the Ministry of Digital Transition designed and trained AI solutions internally for its AI marketplace and to meet the needs of administrations and public services, with other models and use cases being developed with Mistral AI.

Al3omk reports that the Ministry of Digital Transition told the House justice committee it developed the automated answerbot IA Idarati on a new AI-oriented data model covering 400 of about 2,400 administrative procedures, with prototype accuracy above 90 per cent.

Lodj.ma reports that the CNSS launched a tender, estimated at 6 million dirhams, to select a provider for an AI chatbot that CNSS staff will use to query its document and database holdings, with a later phase planned to serve insured members.
Le360, citing expert Marouane Harmach, reports that the Direction generale des impots uses a chatbot to assist taxpayers.
